dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward a sharp, pointed posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no discernible bulges or asymmetrical indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity dorsal reflectance with a uniform cool-toned pixel distribution.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark-pigmented blowhole and a sharply defined, linear longitudinal dorsal ridge along the posterior half of the body.
